welcome.title: 🌾 Welcome to Greenvale
welcome.body:
Put your bags down, the soil is good here.

Greenvale is the village of **Harvester**, the farming game played right inside Discord: you sow, you raise animals, you trade, and you take your time.

start.name: 🌱 Where to start

where.name: 🧭 Finding your way
where.value:
💬 {ch_general} to chat
🆘 {ch_help} when you are stuck
🐞 {ch_bugs} and 💡 {ch_suggestions} to improve the game
📣 {ch_news} and {ch_updates} so you miss nothing

values.name: 🤝 The village spirit
values.value: We help each other, we share harvests and tips, and we leave the square as lovely as we found it.

rules.title: 📜 Village rules
rules.body: A few simple rules so Greenvale stays a good place to live. By staying here you also accept the Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.

respect.name: 🤝 Respect
respect.value: No insults, no harassment, no discrimination. Challenge ideas, never people.

content.name: 🧹 Content
content.value: No shocking or adult content, no spam, no advertising without staff approval. Every channel has a topic, shown at the top of the channel.

fairplay.name: ⚖️ Fair play
fairplay.value: No alternate accounts, no automation, no bug abuse. Bugs get reported in {ch_bugs}, and {role_bughunter} thanks those who do. Cheating leads to an economy suspension.

staff.name: 🛡️ Staff
staff.value: {role_admin} and {role_moderator} have the final say. Trouble with a member? Tell the staff privately instead of settling it in public.

roles.title: 🎭 Pick your roles
roles.body: Click a button to take a role, click again to give it back. You only get pinged for what you chose.

notify.name: 🔔 Notifications
notify.value:
{role_notify_news} important announcements
{role_notify_updates} every game update
{role_notify_events} seasons and events
{role_notify_giveaways} giveaways
{role_notify_polls} community votes

language.name: 🌍 Language
language.value: {role_lang_fr} or {role_lang_en}: tell us which language you would rather be answered in.

ranks.name: 🌻 Village ranks
ranks.value:
{role_sprout}, {role_grower}, {role_grandfarmer} and {role_legend} are handed out by the staff as you progress.
{role_patron}, {role_artisan} and {role_bughunter} thank those who help Harvester grow.

guide.title: 🧭 Getting started with Harvester
guide.body: Everything is played with slash commands, in {ch_fields} and the channels around it. Here are the essentials for your first harvests.

first.name: 🌱 First day
first.value:
`/start` creates your farm
`/tutorial` walks you through it
`/plant`, then `/water`, and finally `/harvest`
`/help` lists every command

daily.name: ☀️ Every day
daily.value:
`/daily` for the reward of the day
`/quests` for your goals
`/weather` and `/season` before sowing
`/almanac` for what is coming

economy.name: 🪙 Trading
economy.value:
`/shop` and `/buy` to gear up
`/sell` and `/market` to move your harvests
`/bank` to put money aside
`/alert` warns you when a price moves
Talk about it in {ch_market}

together.name: 🤝 Together

more.name: ✨ Going further
more.value:
`/animals`, `/fish`, `/mine` and `/craft` open new trades
`/collection`, `/achievements` and `/pass` track your progress
`/postcard` sends a card of your farm
`/lang` switches language, `/settings` tunes your reminders

faq.title: ❓ Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Answers to the questions that come up the most. Yours is missing? Open a post in {ch_help}.

free.name: 🪙 Does Harvester cost anything?
free.value: No. There is no real money shop: gems are only earned by playing, and the premium pass track unlocks with `/vote`.

reset.name: 🗂️ Export or delete my data?
reset.value: `/account export` sends you everything Harvester stores about you. `/account delete` permanently erases your farm.

reminders.name: 🔔 How do I get reminders?
reminders.value: `/settings` tunes your personal reminders. On your own server, `/server reminders` groups everyone's reminders in one channel, like {ch_reminders} here.

bug.name: 🐞 I found a bug
bug.value: Open a post in {ch_bugs} with the command you used, what you expected and what happened.

idea.name: 💡 I have an idea
idea.value: Share it in {ch_suggestions}: one post per idea, and the community votes with ⬆️.

staff.title: 🗝️ Staff memo
staff.body: What is said here stays here. This channel is for coordination, {ch_staff_moderation} keeps a record of decisions.

channels.name: 📂 The council channels
channels.value:
{ch_staff_reports} reports waiting for a decision
{ch_staff_logs} log reserved for {role_founder}, {role_admin} and {role_moderator}
{ch_staff_discord} official Discord messages
{ch_staff_tests} to try a command with nobody watching

ladder.name: ⚖️ Sanction ladder
ladder.value:
① Warning
② Timeout
③ Kick
④ Ban
Every step is written down in {ch_staff_moderation}, with its reason.

tools.name: 🧰 Tools
tools.value: `/admin lookup` shows a player's history, `/admin eco-ban` suspends their economy. These commands are reserved for the bot owners: {role_support} escalates, {role_founder} decides.

note.community_enabled: 🏘️ Community mode enabled: announcement channels, forums and the stage are available.
note.community_failed: 🏘️ Community mode could not be enabled ({reason}). Do it from Server Settings → Enable Community, then run `/serverkit build existing:sync` again.
note.community_fallback: {name}: created as a regular channel, since Community mode is off.
note.forum_fallback: {name}: Discord refused the forum, created as a text channel.

ui.owner_only_body: `/serverkit` builds and tears down entire servers: only the IDs listed in `BOT_OWNER_IDS` may use it.
ui.missing_permissions_body:
To create roles, channels and permissions, I need the **{permissions}** permission on this server.

Server Settings → Roles → my role → **Administrator**, then drag that role to the top of the list. You can take the permission back once the build is done.
ui.unknown_server: I am not a member of server `{id}`. Invite me there first, then run the command again.
ui.busy: A build is already running on this server. Wait for its report before starting another one.
ui.styles_body: Every combination previewed on the same channel. No name holds a hyphen: the words of a text channel are joined with `・`.
ui.existing_sync: realigned with the blueprint (name, category, topic, permissions)
ui.done_body:
➕ **{created}** created ・ ♻️ **{updated}** updated ・ ✅ **{kept}** kept ・ ⚠️ **{failed}** failed
⏱️ {seconds} s
ui.next_body:
① Hand the staff roles to your moderators
② Wire {reminders} with `/server reminders`
③ Take my Administrator permission back if you like: the channels keep my write access
④ Server folders belong to each member's own client: no bot can create them
ui.wipe_confirm_kit:
This deletes the **{channels}** channels and categories and the **{roles}** roles recognised as created by the kit. The rest of the server is left alone.

**This cannot be undone.**
ui.wipe_confirm_all:
This deletes **ALL** channels ({channels}) and **ALL** roles I can manage ({roles}) in **{guild}**. Only this channel is spared, so you can read the report.

**This cannot be undone.**
ui.wipe_name_mismatch: To tear everything down, the `server_name` option must match the server name exactly: **{guild}**.
ui.role_missing: This role no longer exists on the server. Let the staff know.
ui.role_forbidden: This role is not self service.
ui.role_failed: I could not change your roles: my role must sit above {role} and keep the Manage Roles permission.
